figures.caption: Figure 4. Schematic diagram about the electrochemical window (color bars) and the Li chemical potential proﬁle (black line) in the all-solid- state Li-ion battery. The proﬁle of chemical potential is schematic in this plot and may not be linear. The high μLi in the anode (silver) and low μLi in the cathode (blue) are beyond the stability window of the solid electrolyte (green). The observed nominal electrochemical window is extended by the overpotential (dashed line) and by the interphases (orange and yellow), which account for the gap of μLi between solid electrolyte and electrodes across the interfaces.
